_README: SKILLS REVIEW BOWL — the manifest. This file is the game's content and emphasis control (FULL-SPEC §6). Editing it needs no code change: change a weight, turn a pack on or off, add a new pack line when Sam or Will send a unit, save, reload. On a deployed copy, edit dist/bowl.manifest.json the same way. Defense is trained in Practice Week, not in a game (see lanes.defense). The pool is CUMULATIVE (FULL-SPEC §3): every enabled pack is live in every game, regular season and playoffs alike. Nothing here is per-game.

season._note: 8-game regular season, top 4 of 10 make the playoffs (semifinal + final). Quarters are 8 game-minutes, run in chunks per snap, never real time.

rules._note: Hints: 2 escalating hints per item in the regular season and off-season; playoffs run cold (BK, 2026-09-22). hint_form_discount = how much a hint trims the stat gain from a correct answer (0 = hints are free, the default the build order asked for; 1 = each hint costs a point of form). unverified_in_scoring_gates: items whose answer key is not officially verified (answer_verified: false) are kept OUT of gates that decide points — the extra point and every playoff gate — unless this is true. Practice Week (v3): practice_defense_questions is how many film-study items run between games, and defense_gain / defense_loss are how hard each one swings the Defense rating — bigger than an in-game answer, because the week is what sets the defense for the next game. Penalty moments (v5, BK: "its real football, its consequences"): a gain of penalty_min_gain or more can draw a flag — penalty_chance is how often, penalties_per_half caps it, penalty_yards is the walk-off. A right answer keeps the play; a wrong one brings it back and replays the down. Touchdowns are never called back. Two-point try (v5, BK): after a touchdown a student may kick (one question, +1) or go for two (two_point_questions questions, all right = +2, any miss = 0). The six are banked either way.
rules._size_note: BK, 2026-09-27: in-game questions stay short; document questions go where the game already stops (training, facilities, free agency), the bigger rewards. A question is LONG if it has an image or a cue longer than short_cue_words (a source line alone doesn't make it long); or if cue + prompt + options run past short_max_words. In-game gates ask SHORT only (src/content/dealer.js).
rules._require_note: The Arena's rule (CONVENTIONS §7): two hints and a reason line on every question. true = a question short of that is held back and listed in the content report; it comes back the day its author's words land (BK chose this, 2026-09-27, 'A'). false = everything plays.

lanes._note: Each content lane builds ONE team stat. That is the stat layer (FULL-SPEC §2.2): a team that knows the material throws tighter and breaks more tackles. Labels are what a student reads.

hawk_box.title: BE A HAWK
hawk_box._source: In/ruling-2026-09-27-growth-coaching-bank-LOCKED.md §5 Habits, verbatim. After a win: Working with others. After a loss: When things get hard. Otherwise: Showing up and Using time well. Rotates by week.
after_win: Being right only helps your partner if they can follow you.
Listen first, then answer. It's harder than it sounds and it works everywhere.
Good teammates make the whole group better. That's a skill too.
after_loss: Bad day? Do one set. Small wins count.
Everybody hits a wall. The ones who get better are the ones who come back.
Asking for help is a skill, not a weakness.
otherwise: Showing up is half of it. The other half is what you do once you're there.
Some days are hard just getting here. You got here. That counts.
Ten minutes of real focus beats an hour of half-attention.
Ten minutes, three times a week, beats two hours the night before. Same with anything you want to get good at.

code_new: New code. Screenshot it or write it down. It's your whole season.
Screenshot that code. Future you will thank you.
code_restored: Code worked. Your season's back. Nothing lost.
You saved your code and it paid off. That's planning ahead.
